title: rhus pulcherrima
intro: Rhus pulcherrima, commonly known as Florida key West or Hawaiian hibiscus, is a flowering plant in the family Anacardiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and acting as an antioxidant to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rhus pulcherrima include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents also contribute to the plant's potential in treating conditions like cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases.
